steps.content: You've cleaned up the living room. What should have been done has been completed, and even the ones that didn't need to be done are finished. At least now, the room is no longer a junkyard.

Even though the house owner will turn the place to its original state once she's back, at least for now, you don't have to worry about tripping over some random stuff and falling face first. You lean back in the chair in front of the computer and let out a long sigh.
Based on the progress of the job, you probably still have an hour or two of free time left. Time to get to business.

Unlike the public and stable surface web, the world of DisMyth is like the deep sea. It's a dangerous place where countless unidentified information sources mingle, exchanging intelligence in the dark, forming transient whirlpools of information.

By using Angell's account, known as the "Top Hitman," you've gained access to valuable intelligence from her account history and the contacts seeking her service. Now, as the investigator closest to DisMyth, you have the best chance to rescue yourself.
You note down some of her usual contacts, and those who have requested her services—especially, those after you. Then you purposefully post some garbled codes on DisMyth.
Soon, someone responds in garbled text processed by the same encryption method, initiating an online conversation with you.

[The following messages are decrypted] User_W21: Got the intel. Chief, are you okay? T_T Haven't been harvested or sold off somewhere, right? Are you still in DisCity? We're worrying sick, please take good care of yourself. QwQ You: Not sure where I am, but everything's fine. Let's cut to the chase. It's easy to get exposed when we're not familiar with the dark web. User_W21: Okay. T_T

It must be the action team formed by the MBCC Intelligence Department and the 9th Agency, you're not sure who is involved, but this isn't the time for detailed reports. As long as the codes match up, that's all that matters. You've been posting ciphertext and secretly calling for help for days.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: The attacks are still going?

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: Yes, even worse after you were captured.
<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: Has <color=#fb9259>Fish</color> revealed who hired her yet?

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: No, they haven't got in touch. Her client seems experienced. They're staying under the radar.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: But thankfully it's a series of cases, not individual ones, finding what these people have in common should really help.

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: Nine is tracking several gangs. Since order has been restored in West District, it's harder for gangs to survive these days. That's why many of them are turning to DisMyth to make a living.
W21 gives Angell a code name, Fish. Nine naturally refers to the 9th Agency. W21 has been refusing to disclose their identity, but you have a feeling it's Wynn.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Alright, I'll keep an eye on Fish's regulars. Can't trace IPs on the dark web, but we can try tracking her gigs in real life.

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: It's dangerous!!! Pleeeeaaase stay put and just wait for rescue! You'll scare us to death!! QwQ

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: I'm kidnapped right now, it's better for me to help out than do nothing. I'll try to find the electricity bill account number to help you guys pinpoint my location.
Encrypting and decrypting these messages are quite taxing. You glance at the time, Angell's commission is probably over, she could be back any moment now.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Fish will be back soon. Let's call it a day. I'm counting on you guys to set the trap.

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: Please be careful. T_T
You swiftly clear the chat history, eliminating all the evidence. As you're about to log off, you receive one last message in the chatroom.

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: But why would Fish listen to you? She's the one who kidnapped you.

<color=#fb9259>User_W21</color>: Maybe there's something special about you? The shackles? Or perhaps, your charisma...
You pause for a moment and decide not to reply. After deleting all the history, you close the chatroom and return to the commission page.
You don't want to spend too much time pondering on the question Wynn posed right now. And as you're looking to divert your attention...
